title: Base Power footer
description: A deep forest-green footer: five columns of white links under small grey uppercase headings, dark download badges on the right, a contact row with social icons, the company name set huge and faint across the full width, then a hairline, the small print, a round seal and a lime uppercase sign-off. Two columns on phones.
notes: the giant name is an SVG word stretched to the width (short names read best)
badges and the seal are plain text (no store or certifier logos)
name: basepowercompany-footer

props.name: brand
props.description: the company name, set huge and faint across the footer

props.name: columns
props.description: the link columns (five across on desktop, two on phones)

props.name: badges
props.type: { icon?: ReactNode; top: string; label: string; href: string; }[]
props.description: small dark download badges: an icon, a tiny top line and a label

props.name: contact
props.description: the contact blocks: an optional bold heading and lines

props.name: socials
props.type: { label: string; href: string; icon: ReactNode; }[]

props.name: legal
props.description: the small print paragraphs; the first is set bold

props.name: legalLinks
props.description: the underlined policy links at the very bottom

props.name: seal
props.description: a round certification seal beside the small print (two short lines)

props.name: signoff
props.description: the sign-off line at the bottom right, with an optional icon above
